scientific_integrity: Direct symbolic matrix and polynomial calculations, exact separability and irreducibility certificates, and reproducible independent finite-field cross-checks. Classical Cartier, isogeny and Newton polygon facts are credited; no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth marked coefficient pairs of the specified characteristic-five genus-four family, not moduli-isomorphism classes or arbitrary genus-four curves. Point counting in finite extensions is a cross-check; geometric statements use exact polynomial and irreducibility certificates. An equivalent historic genus-two supersingularity table remains a priority risk.
title: A fifteen-point supersingular locus in a two-parameter genus-four square-Jacobian family
